Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 50: the slip of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploys -1 (to a minimum of 3) for each Imperial starship on table. May add 5 pilots, 6 passengers, 1 vehicle, and 3 starfighters. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2.”), word for word the text of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
